verdict.rationale: Lovable's first-party collaboration docs say you can invite designers, developers and agencies into a project, where everyone sees changes as they happen. When several people build in the same project, each can work in their own draft with a separate chat and preview. Workspace-level features such as shared skills and members connecting MCP registry servers further support a shared team workspace. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time collaboration, and documentation of roles/permissions and how drafts are merged back.
